name: Dunhallow
description: A desert village of flat-roofed mud brick, built around a well that has never run dry.

gate.name: Village Gate
gate.description: A low arch in a mud-brick wall, shaded by a date palm. Children have scratched pictures into the plaster, and a dog sleeps in the shade.

square.name: Dunhallow Square
square.description: A dusty square with the well at its heart. Flat roofs throw hard shadows, and nobody hurries. The inn stands on the north side, with a faded blue door.

inn.name: The Blue Door Inn
inn.description: A cool, dim common room, thick-walled against the sun. Shutters stripe the floor with light, and a beaded curtain hangs across the way to the back rooms.
